description: PJM generation by fuel type — MW generated and percentage of total from coal, natural gas, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, oil, storage and other, per published interval. Use for "what is PJM burning right now", "PJM nuclear share", "PJM coal vs gas". Requires a PJM API key.

_apiKey.description: PJM Data Miner 2 subscription key. Free at https://apiportal.pjm.com/.

datetime_beginning_ept.description: Eastern Prevailing Time range filter, e.g. "9/17/2026 00:00 to 9/17/2026 23:59". Omit for the most recent intervals.

fuel_type.description: Filter to one fuel type, e.g. "Nuclear", "Gas", "Coal", "Wind".

name: pjm_generation_fuel_mix
title: Pjm Generation Fuel Mix
